modalities.evidence: a standard T1w image was acquired for each subject
each subject underwent an fMRI scan with blocs of CO2 inhalation challenges
breath CO2 was recorded using a capnograph

output.population: Thirty-five healthy adult subjects with no prior history of neurological or psychiatric disorder, ages 23–67
output.summary: Healthy adults scanned with anatomical and functional MRI during CO2 inhalation challenges and a resting-state session, with capnograph CO2 recordings, comparing cerebrovascular reactivity from breathing challenges to resting-state relative CVR. Includes fMRIPrep and CVRmap derivatives.
